name: elbow lift - reverse push-up
description: A reverse push-up driven by pressing the elbows into a bench to lift the upper body and engage the upper back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your elbows bent and supported on a sturdy bench beside your torso.
Keep your legs extended and brace your trunk.
Drive your elbows down into the bench to lift your upper body slightly and squeeze your upper back.
Pause briefly, then lower with control without pushing through your palms.
